_about.join: every DRAWN vertex takes the nearest rBodyData capsule, in glb world space (capsule = boneWorld @ (point/100), radius/100). Slot indexes the dt_tune damage table.
_about.tables: read from the ROM .dtt: 8 rows x 10 bytes, table count = 2 - byte[0x12]. What a second table represents is NOT established -- do not name it.
_about.names: community part names (MHGU-Monster-Info verified sets), where they exist. The ROM has no part-name table.
_about.bin: <em>.bin: u32 primCount, primCount x u32 vertexCount, then the slot bytes concatenated in primitive order (the same order the viewer counts prims in).
